title: Tensor summand differentials on localized pure tensors
statement: Let K,L be cochain complexes of R-module sheaves on a site, and p,q,t integers with p+q=t. The summand differentials d1,d2 from K^p tensor L^q to Tot(K tensor L)^(t+1) are those of [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. At every object V, d1 sends the section-map image of x tensor y to the (p+1,q) summand image of dK(x) tensor y. The map d2 sends it to (-1)^p times the (p,q+1) summand image of x tensor dL(y). The section map is [lem-sc-hom-tensor-degreewise].

source.place: Section 03EK, functoriality of tensor sheafification; More on Algebra Tag 0A5Y, tensor differential

proof.text: Use mapBifunctor.d₁_eq and d₂_eq to express each summand differential as its whiskering followed by the next summand inclusion. The cochain signs reduce definitionally to one and p.negOnePow.
Evaluate tensor section-map naturality on x tensor y. ModuleCat tensorHom_tmul identifies the tensor map with the tensor of its component values.

Use f tensor identity for d1 and identity tensor g for d2, then evaluate the summand inclusions. Evaluation is additive and preserves integer scalar multiplication, so the second sign passes through unchanged.

theorem homTensor_pure_differentials (K L : CochainComplex Mod ℤ)
    (p q t : ℤ) (h : p + q = t) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
    ∀ (V : Cᵒᵖ) (x : (K.X p).val.obj V) (y : (L.X q).val.obj V),
      ((HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.d₁ K L (curriedTensor Mod)
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ) p q (t + 1)).val.app V).hom
        (((homTensorSectionMap R (K.X p) (L.X q)).app V).hom
          (x ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj V] y)) =
        ((CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor K L (curriedTensor Mod)
          (p + 1) q (t + 1) (by omega)).val.app V).hom
          (((homTensorSectionMap R (K.X (p + 1)) (L.X q)).app V).hom
            (((K.d p (p + 1)).val.app V).hom x ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj V] y)) ∧
      ((HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.d₂ K L (curriedTensor Mod)
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ) p q (t + 1)).val.app V).hom
        (((homTensorSectionMap R (K.X p) (L.X q)).app V).hom
          (x ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj V] y)) =
        p.negOnePow • ((CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor K L (curriedTensor Mod)
          p (q + 1) (t + 1) (by omega)).val.app V).hom
          (((homTensorSectionMap R (K.X p) (L.X (q + 1))).app V).hom
            (x ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj V] ((L.d q (q + 1)).val.app V).hom y))
